```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

from pcntoolkit import (
    NormativeModel,
    NormData,
    plot_centiles
)


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

current_dir = Path.cwd().parent

model_dir = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "normative_model"
    / "BLR"
)

plot_dir = (
    model_dir
    / "centile_plots"
)

plot_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)


# ============================================================
# LOAD MODEL
# ============================================================

model = NormativeModel.load(
    str(model_dir)
)

print("BLR model loaded")


# ============================================================
# LOAD MODELLING DATA
# ============================================================

model_df = pd.read_csv(
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
    / "Model_dataframe.csv"
)

response_vars = [
    f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)
]

batch_effects = [
    "Dataset_name"
]

covariates = [
    col for col in model_df.columns
    if col not in (
        [
            "Scan_id",
            "Participant_Id",
            "Dataset_name"
        ]
        + response_vars
    )
]


# ============================================================
# CREATE NORMDATA FOR SCATTER DATA
# ============================================================

norm_data = NormData.from_dataframe(
    name="DigitalRodent",
    dataframe=model_df,
    covariates=covariates,
    batch_effects=batch_effects,
    response_vars=response_vars,
    remove_Nan=False
)


# ============================================================
# CONTINUOUS COVARIATES
# ============================================================

continuous_covariates = [
    "Age(week)",
    "MRI",
    "MRI T.R.",
    "MRI T.E.",
    "FD average",
    "FD maximum"
]

continuous_covariates = [
    col for col in continuous_covariates
    if col in covariates
]


# ============================================================
# CENTILE PLOTS
# ============================================================

for covariate in continuous_covariates:

    print("\nPlotting:", covariate)

    figures = plot_centiles(
        model,
        scatter_data=norm_data,
        covariate=covariate,
        centiles=[
            0.05,
            0.50,
            0.95
        ],
        save_dir=str(plot_dir)
    )

print("\nCentile plots saved to:")
print(plot_dir)

```
